# ui::ToggleProvider

Header: `winui/ui/Automation.hpp`.

The Toggle pattern: an on, off or indeterminate state a click advances, as a check box has. Implement every member.

## toggle_value

```cpp
virtual ToggleState toggle_value() const = 0
```

The current state.

## toggle_next

```cpp
virtual bool toggle_next() = 0
```

Advance to the next state as a click would; true when it did (false when disabled).
